description.html: With a volume of 30 liters and dimensions of 40x25x30 cm, this terrarium includes a handmade 3D background. The background imitates natural relief, such as rock or bark, and adds depth to the space so animals can climb, hide and feel more secure.

With a floor area of 40x25 cm, this terrarium allows natural movement for ground-dwelling species and proper temperature zoning: a warm spot under the spot lamp and a cooler area on the opposite side. The ventilation openings are placed to create natural airflow from bottom to top, which maintains optimal humidity.

When ordering, you choose the film pattern and the shape of the 3D background. We handmake all our terrariums in Novi Sad, so customization is always possible, from dimensions to the way it opens. We ship by courier throughout Serbia.
